overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law because the original October 4 notice topic "Policy Matters," without more detail, was insufficiently specific, though not for the reason the complaint alleged.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the October 4 notice topic '5.1 Discuss Items for Review by Subcommittee' did not identify the specific policy matters the chair anticipated discussing.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the topic included on the original notice, “Policy Matters,” without any additional information was insufficiently specific to inform the public of the anticipated nature of the discussion.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
